name: igly-canvas
description: Pick from 2,400+ free design templates or draw flowcharts, mind maps, roadmaps, wireframes, storyboards and moodboards on an editable Igly canvas, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription: Pick a free design template (menus, posters, social posts, invitations, thumbnails) from a picker right in the chat and have it rewritten for your brand, or ask for a flowchart, mind map, roadmap, wireframe, storyboard or moodboard. Edit everything by hand, export a PNG, and open it in the full Igly editor. Free with an Igly account.
